top1.title: 【2026-11-25】Anthropic株が公開価格割れ、AI企業の評価に警戒感
top1.lead1: Anthropic株が公開価格83ドルを下回り、一時76ドルまで下落した。
top1.lead2: 株価低迷が続けば、未上場AI企業の評価や他社のIPO計画にも圧力が及ぶ可能性がある。

top10.title: [2026-11-25] Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, raising concerns over AI company valuations
top10.summary: Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price, briefly dropping to $76. If the slump persists, it could affect valuations and IPO plans for privately held AI companies.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] UK's NCSC warns of rising AI-driven cyberattacks
top10.summary: The UK's NCSC reported an increase in intrusions using autonomous tools. It pointed to the rapid exploitation of long-neglected weaknesses, such as weak passwords, rather than new types of vulnerabilities, as the problem.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] Meta's Muse AI integrated into Instagram DMs, with Japan included in rollout
top10.summary: Users can now ask Muse to explain posts, plan trips and more through Instagram DMs. The rollout has begun in five countries, including Japan, while a feature for organizing saved posts will be offered in the US and Canada.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] Tidal to ban fully AI-generated songs, with large-scale removals starting in December
top10.summary: Tidal will ban fully AI-generated songs and begin removing them on December 9. It plans to remove more than 29 million tracks by the end of the year, while continuing to allow music made with AI assistance.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] Analysis: Amazon's Decart acquisition aims to strengthen Trainium through software
top10.summary: TechCrunch examined Amazon's acquisition of Decart's technology and team. It analyzed the aim of incorporating optimization technology into Trainium to narrow the performance gap with Nvidia.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] NYT asks contributing photographers to avoid latest Photoshop over AI feature concerns
top10.summary: The NYT asked contributing photographers not to use Photoshop 2027 for assignments. There are concerns that metadata indicating AI generation could be attached unintentionally; details of the features involved are unclear.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] Pinterest lets parents limit children's exposure to AI-generated content
top10.summary: Pinterest expanded its parental controls. Parents can now adjust the amount of AI-generated content shown to their children, as well as video autoplay, notifications and other settings.

top10.title: [2026-11-25] Analysis: Investors eye solar and long-duration storage to power AI data centers
top10.summary: A representative of G2VP, an investor in Crusoe, advocated securing power through solar energy and long-duration energy storage. While highlighting advantages in deployment speed and scale, the representative said widespread adoption would take time.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
